in_sanskrit.name: कोन्दल
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: कोन्द (Konda) - mountain, ल (la) - Lord. Thus, Kondal means 'Lord of the mountains'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit word 'konda' which means mountain.

in_hindi.name: कोन्दल
in_hindi.long_meaning: पर्वत (Parvat) - mountain, पति (Pat) - Lord. Thus, Kondal means 'Lord of the mountains' in Hindi as well.

in_tamil.name: கோண்டல்
in_tamil.long_meaning: மலை (Malai) - mountain, அடிகள் (Adigal) - Lord. Thus, Kondal means 'Lord of the mountains' in Tamil.

in_telugu.name: కొందల్లు
in_telugu.long_meaning: గీర్జీ (Gajjalu) - mountain, పతి (Pat) - Lord. Thus, Kondal means 'Lord of the mountains' in Telugu.

in_marathi.name: Kondal
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे God of Mountains
in_marathi.long_meaning: Kondal हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Kondal is a Sanskrit and Tamil name derived from the word 'konda' which means mountain or hill. The name is believed to be associated with Lord Murugan, the Hindu god of war, love, and mountains.

in_bengali.meaning: হিন্দু নাম যার অর্থ God of Mountains
